"""Assemble the owned file:// Maven repository for the RN Android consumer from approved inputs only.

Binaries: approved artifact-index entries (androidDebug, nativeBuildTools, kotlinSdkRuntime) plus the
four 8a87389 addendum JARs. Bytes come from earlier verified local copies or, if absent, from the
entry's exact qualified_url over HTTPS; every byte is checked against the approved SHA256 pin and
SHA512 when recorded. Metadata: root's captured POM/module files, each checked against its recorded
URL/SHA256 provenance, plus the addendum's recorded repository responses. Nothing else is added.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import subprocess

repo_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
out = here / 'repo'
assert not out.exists(), 'fresh repository required'
review = repo_root / 'target/phase-seven-dependencies/native-source-review'
addendum_docs = repo_root / 'docs/implementation/phase-seven-plugin-addendum'
addendum = repo_root / 'target/phase-seven-plugin-addendum/archive-review'
fetched_dir = here / 'fetched'
fetched_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
record = {'binaries': [], 'metadata': [], 'fetched': []}


def sha(data, algorithm='sha256'):
    return hashlib.new(algorithm, data).hexdigest()


def layout(coordinate, name):
    group, artifact, version = coordinate.split(':')[:3]
    return Path(group.replace('.', '/')) / artifact / version / name


def place(relative, data, source, kind):
    target = out / relative
    if target.exists():
        assert target.read_bytes() == data, ('conflicting bytes', relative)
        return
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_bytes(data)
    record[kind].append({'path': str(relative), 'sha256': sha(data), 'source': source})


index = json.loads((repo_root / 'docs/implementation/phase-seven-dependencies/native/artifact-index.json').read_text())
wanted = {'androidDebug', 'nativeBuildTools', 'kotlinSdkRuntime'}
verified_runtime = {x['coordinate'] + '|' + Path(x['path']).name: repo_root / x['path']
                    for x in json.loads((repo_root / 'target/phase-seven-rn/maven/verified.json').read_text())['verified']}
for entry in index['artifacts']:
    if not wanted & set(entry['configurations']):
        continue
    coordinate, name = entry['coordinate'], entry['name']
    candidates = [verified_runtime.get(coordinate + '|' + name),
                  review / 'artifact-byte-review' / (coordinate.replace(':', '__') + '__' + name),
                  fetched_dir / layout(coordinate, name)]
    path = next((p for p in candidates if p is not None and p.is_file()), None)
    source = str(path.relative_to(repo_root)) if path else None
    if path is None:
        path = fetched_dir / layout(coordinate, name)
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        url = entry['qualified_url']
        assert url.startswith('https://'), url
        log = subprocess.run(['curl', '--fail', '--location', '--proto', '=https', '--proto-redir', '=https',
                              '--tlsv1.2', '--retry', '2', '--silent', '--show-error', '--output',
                              str(path) + '.part', url], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True,
                             timeout=600)
        record['fetched'].append({'coordinate': coordinate, 'url': url, 'exit_code': log.returncode, 'output': log.stdout})
        (here / 'prepare-repo.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
        assert log.returncode == 0, (coordinate, log.stdout)
        Path(str(path) + '.part').rename(path)
        source = url
    data = path.read_bytes()
    expected = entry.get('sha256') or entry.get('sha256_pin')
    assert sha(data) == expected, (coordinate, name, 'sha256 mismatch')
    if entry.get('sha512'):
        assert sha(data, 'sha512') == entry['sha512'], (coordinate, name, 'sha512 mismatch')
    place(layout(coordinate, name), data, source, 'binaries')

bundle = json.loads((addendum_docs / 'bundle.json').read_text())
for item in bundle['additional_artifacts']:
    name = item['url'].rsplit('/', 1)[1]
    data = (addendum / layout(item['coordinate'], name)).read_bytes()
    assert sha(data) == item['sha256'], item['coordinate']
    place(layout(item['coordinate'], name), data, item['url'], 'binaries')
for response in json.loads((addendum_docs / 'repository-responses.json').read_text()):
    name = response['url'].rsplit('/', 1)[1]
    data = (addendum / layout(response['coordinate'], name)).read_bytes()
    assert sha(data) == response['sha256'], response['coordinate']
    place(layout(response['coordinate'], name), data, response['url'], 'metadata')

provenance = {}
for listing in ['metadata-provenance.json', 'selected-metadata-provenance.json', 'selected-patched-metadata-provenance.json']:
    for item in json.loads((review / 'maven' / listing).read_text()):
        assert provenance.setdefault(item['file'], item)['sha256'] == item['sha256'], item['file']
for relative, item in sorted(provenance.items()):
    data = (review / 'maven' / relative).read_bytes()
    assert sha(data) == item['sha256'], relative
    place(Path(relative), data, item['url'], 'metadata')

record['counts'] = {k: len(v) for k, v in record.items() if isinstance(v, list)}
(here / 'prepare-repo.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print('HOYA_RN_ANDROID_REPO_PREPARED ' + json.dumps(record['counts']), flush=True)
